artists.note:
This is a placeholder. To add real K-POP artists, you need to:
1. Get photos of K-POP artists
2. Use the add_artist.py script to generate face encodings
3. The encodings will be automatically added to this file

instructions: To add artists, run: python backend/add_artist.py <artist_name> <group_name> <image_path>
